connector.name: MCP by ar-agents
connector.registryDescription: Argentine business automation: Mercado Pago, AFIP/ARCA, WhatsApp, banking, shipping (7 packages).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ar-agents account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MP_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Mercado Pago access token (TEST- prefix for sandbox, APP_USR- for production). Enables MP tools.

env.name: AFIP_CERT_PEM
env.description: AFIP/ARCA X.509 certificate (PEM string) for WSAA authentication. Enables CUIT padron + factura electronica tools.

env.name: AFIP_KEY_PEM
env.description: AFIP/ARCA private key (PEM string) for WSAA authentication. Required if AFIP_CERT_PEM is set.

env.name: AFIP_CUIT
env.description: Issuer CUIT (Argentine tax ID) registered with the AFIP cert. Format: 20-XXXXXXXX-X.

env.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API token. Enables WhatsApp tools.

env.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
env.description: Meta WhatsApp Business phone-number ID. Required if WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.
